description: This file provides Windows compatibility functions and definitions for Git, including path validation, UTF-8/UTF-16 conversions, SSL socket handling, and process management, specifically tailored for MinGW on Windows.

methods.name: mingw_core_config
methods.description: Function to set or get configuration variables in MinGW environment.

methods.name: mingw_SSL_set_fd
methods.description: Sets the SSL file descriptor using Windows handle.

methods.name: mingw_SSL_set_rfd
methods.description: Sets the SSL read file descriptor using Windows handle.

methods.name: mingw_SSL_set_wfd
methods.description: Sets the SSL write file descriptor using Windows handle.

methods.name: convert_slashes
methods.description: Converts backslashes in paths to forward slashes for Windows compatibility.

methods.name: mingw_query_user_email
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's email address.

methods.name: is_path_owned_by_current_sid
methods.description: Checks if a path is owned by the current user SID.

methods.name: is_valid_win32_path
methods.description: Validates Windows path segments for illegal characters, reserved names, and formatting.

methods.name: xutftowcsn
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 string to UTF-16LE wide characters with specified length.

methods.name: xutftowcs
methods.description: Converts null-terminated UTF-8 string to UTF-16LE wide characters.

methods.name: xutftowcs_path
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 string to UTF-16LE wide characters, suitable for file paths.

methods.name: xwcstoutf
methods.description: Converts UTF-16LE wide characters to UTF-8 string.

methods.name: wmain
methods.description: Main entry point for Windows Unicode command-line applications, re-encodes parameters to UTF-8.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Standard C main function for the application.

methods.name: open_in_gdb
methods.description: Opens a GDB debugger attached to the current process for debugging.

methods.name: err_win_to_posix
methods.description: Converts Windows error codes to POSIX error codes.

methods.name: have_unix_sockets
methods.description: Checks for Unix socket support in MinGW environment.
